message: Last week, while I was assembling our emergency kit for the upcoming storm, my kids were busy transforming it into a makeshift fort. I guess in their eyes, a weather radio and flashlights are just fancy toys. After a slight negotiation, we settled on a family game plan: they get to help build the fort, and I get to make sure we have what we need. Who knew prepping could double as a family bonding activity? Sometimes, a little teamwork makes all the difference.
